name: MyElectricalData
description: MyElectricalData is the local client of the MyElectricalData gateway for French Linky smart meters. It keeps the consumption and production history from Enedis in its own database, shows it in a web interface with costs per tariff, Tempo and EcoWatt, and exports it to Home Assistant or VictoriaMetrics.

notes.text: Requires a free account on www.v2.myelectricaldata.fr with the Enedis consent: its Client ID and Client Secret are asked during the install.
The gateway allows 50 uncached requests per day per account: do not run several instances with the same credentials.
